description: This PHP source file defines an API class `EmployeeOnLeaveTodayConfigAPI` within the `OrangeHRM\Domain` namespace, providing endpoints to get and update configuration settings related to displaying employees on leave today on the dashboard. It primarily handles configuration retrieval and modification via HTTP GET and PUT methods, utilizing various API and validation traits, and is part of the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveTodayConfigAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to get and set configuration related to employees on leave today displayed on the HR dashboard.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current setting for 'show only accessible employees on leave today' from configuration and returns it as a JSON response.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the GET endpoint, excluding the 'id' parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the configuration setting for 'show only accessible employees on leave today' based on request payload.

methods.description: Defines validation rules for the update (PUT) endpoint, requiring a boolean value for the setting.
